story.title: Escalation in Middle East as US and Saudi Forces Target Iranian Militias Amid Missile Attacks
story.summary: The conflict in the Middle East has intensified as the US and Saudi Arabia launched airstrikes against Iranian-backed militias in Iraq. This escalation follows a series of missile attacks from Iran, which were intercepted by US forces and Jordanian military. The US Central Command reported successfully thwarting an attempted surprise attack by Iran, marking a significant increase in hostilities after a brief period of calm.

timeline_highlights.title: Trump Issues Threats Against Iranian Infrastructure Amid Strait of Hormuz Tensions
timeline_highlights.summary: US President Donald Trump has threatened to target Iranian bridges and power plants in retaliation for any attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz. He stated that for each ship fired upon by Iranian forces, the US would respond by destroying a corresponding piece of Iranian infrastructure. This escalation comes amid ongoing tensions in the region and rising oil prices.
key_facts: Trump threatened to destroy Iranian infrastructure for each ship attacked in the Strait of Hormuz.
The threat follows continued Iranian attacks on shipping in the region.
Oil prices have surged amid the escalating tensions.

event_overview.title: About Iran War
event_overview.subject: Iran War
event_overview.summary: The Iran War refers to the 2026 international armed conflict centered on Iran, the United States and Israel, with effects extending across the Persian Gulf and neighboring states. U.S. combat operations began on February 28, 2026; the conflict has also made security and commercial navigation in the Strait of Hormuz a central issue.

facts.label: Start date
facts.value: The United States notified the UN Security Council that it commenced combat operations against Iran on February 28, 2026; U.S. energy officials likewise identify military action on that date as the point after which Hormuz traffic was effectively disrupted.

facts.label: Principal parties and stated U.S. purpos
facts.value: In its UN notification, the United States said it was acting in cooperation with Israel, citing protection of U.S. forces and regional partners and the free flow of maritime commerce through the Strait of Hormuz. These are the U.S. government's stated objectives, not an independent legal finding.

facts.label: Legal position asserted by the United St
facts.value: The United States characterized its operations as necessary and proportionate self-defense under Article 51 of the UN Charter, including collective self-defense of Israel.

facts.label: Why the Strait of Hormuz matters
facts.value: The strait lies between Iran and Oman and links the Persian Gulf to the Gulf of Oman and Arabian Sea. In the first half of 2025, about 20.9 million barrels per day of oil—roughly one-fifth of global petroleum-liquids consumption—moved through it, while alternative routes could replace only part of disrupted flows.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline covers chosen developments on July 22-23, 2026—including military threats, U.S. war-powers action and oil-market effects—and does not attempt to provide a complete account of the conflict, diplomacy, or humanitarian consequences.

explore_lenses.label: Why did Iraq become the new frontline?
explore_lenses.title: Disputed drone attacks drew Iraq into the conflict
explore_lenses.summary: The strikes followed Saudi allegations that drones launched from Iraq targeted its oil infrastructure. Baghdad had already opened an inquiry, while Iraqi armed groups denied responsibility and pointed to the Houthis’ separate claims.

claims.text: Saudi Arabia said it had downed drones launched from Iraqi territory against oil facilities and called on Baghdad to prevent Iraq from being used as a launch point.
Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi ordered Iraqi security agencies to examine Saudi-provided evidence and said legal action would follow if involvement were proven.
The Islamic Resistance in Iraq denied responsibility for the reported drone attacks, calling the Saudi allegations fabrications; the Houthis separately claimed attacks on Saudi oil facilities.

The U.S. Defense Department had said on July 14 that Iran-aligned militias carried out more than 600 attacks on U.S. citizens and facilities in Iraq between February and April, framing militia disarmament as central to Iraqi sovereignty.

explore_lenses.label: What confirmed steps come next?
explore_lenses.title: Iraq is investigating; further strikes are possible
explore_lenses.summary: No new ceasefire or negotiation has been confirmed after the renewed attacks. The immediate documented actions are an Iraqi security meeting and a U.S. warning that further attacks could trigger additional military action.

claims.text: Prime Minister al-Zaidi called an emergency National Security Council meeting on July 29 to address the U.S.-Saudi strikes.
CENTCOM warned that further attacks on U.S. personnel or Saudi energy infrastructure could prompt further U.S. action; Saudi Arabia said it did not seek escalation but would respond to aggression.
A planned July 30 visit by al-Zaidi to Saudi Arabia was reportedly postponed indefinitely, according to two Iraqi officials who spoke anonymously to AP.
Separately, Washington still says it intends to end the Global Coalition’s military mission in Iraq by September 30, while continuing bilateral U.S.-Iraq defense discussions.

related_stories.title: Federal Reserve Considers Interest Rate Decision Amid Inflation Concerns
related_stories.summary: Policymakers at the Federal Reserve are meeting to discuss interest rates, with expectations leaning towards maintaining the current rates. However, persistent inflation concerns could influence future decisions for the remainder of 2026.

related_stories.title: Federal Reserve Faces Pressure to Adjust Interest Rates Amid Inflation Concerns
related_stories.summary: As the Federal Reserve prepares for its July meeting, Chairman Kevin M. Warsh is under pressure to address rising inflation. The rate-setting committee will decide whether to raise interest rates or maintain the current levels, with inflation and affordability being key issues influencing their decision.

related_stories.title: Iran Conducts Attacks on US Bases and Ships Amid Trump-Netanyahu Meeting
related_stories.summary: Iran has launched attacks on US military bases in the Middle East, marking a significant escalation in hostilities. This includes the reported 600th attack on US forces in Iraq. Additionally, Iran's Revolutionary Guard has targeted three oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, claiming they ignored warnings. These events coincide with a meeting between Trump and Netanyahu.
